job.job_description:
Educational Requirements
Bachelor of Engineering
Service Line
Information Systems
Responsibilities
Design and develop GenAI applications using LLMs such as GPT, Llama, Gemini, or similar models.Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) based solutions.Develop AI-powered chatbots, virtual assistants, and intelligent automation solutions.Create and manage prompts for improved model performance and accuracy.Integrate AI solutions with APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.Fine-tune and evaluate LLMs for specific business use cases.Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.
Additional Responsibilities:
Experience with model fine-tuning and AI agent frameworks.Knowledge of MLOps and AI deployment practices.Familiarity with Azure OpenAI Services.
Technical and Professional Requirements:
Strong programming experience in Python.Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and RAG.Knowledge of LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Databases (FAISS, Pinecone, ChromaDB).Experience with REST APIs and cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP).Understanding of Machine Learning and NLP concepts.Good problem-solving and communication skills.

Technology->AI-Data science->Machine Learning

Technology->AI-AI Engineering->AI/ML Solution Architecture and Design->generative ai
